━━ Quick Start ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
1. Connect drone, click [Refresh] to get EID / card / profiles

━━ Switch Card Slot ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
2. [Switch to SIM] / [Switch to eSIM] to change physical slot
 Module will hard-reset, ~15s to recover

━━ Profile Management ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
3. Click [Get Profiles] to load profile list into dropdown
4. Select a profile from the dropdown
5. Click [Enable] / [Disable] / [Delete] to operate
 Only one profile can be active at a time
 Disable before deleting an active profile

━━ Download New Profile (Write) ━━━━━━━
6. Select SM-DP+ server from dropdown
7. Enter Matching ID (from carrier)
8. Click [Write], takes 30s~2min
 Click [Refresh] to verify after completion
